title: Business Development & Marketing Executive - Law Firm

title: Campaign Reporting Executive
description:
Our well established publishing client near Marlow, Bucks are looking for a Campaign Reporting Executive to join their growing team.

Are you a whizz with Excel and PowerPoint and comfortable working with numbers and using formulas?

This is an excellent opportunity to advance your career and fully emerge yourself in data and presenting data. You will be turning campaign data into accurate, polished reports and will be using your strong analytical and numerical mindset in the process!

This is a Hybrid role with around 2 days per week being office based and 3 days a week at home.

Main responsibilities for the Campaign Reporting Executive role are:
- Producing accurate, timely and professionally presented client campaign reports, primarily using PowerPoint and Excel.
- Extracting and reviewing data from Power BI and other internal systems, checking completeness, consistency and accuracy before reporting.
- Reporting on a range of campaign activity, including live webinars, on-demand content, email, social media and other digital campaigns.
- Analysing campaign performance measures such as registrations, attendance, on-demand views, engagement, viewing duration and conversion.
- Analysing audience demographics, including geography, job title, specialty and areas of interest, where relevant data is available.
- Creating clear tables, charts and supporting commentary to communicate results effectively.
- Working to agreed reporting templates, deadlines and quality-control processes, ensuring consistency in presentation and terminology.
- Responding to internal and occasional client queries about campaign results, explaining data clearly and confidently.

Skills required for the Campaign Reporting Executive role are:
- Around 2+ years' experience in reporting, data management, business intelligence support or a similar role.
- Strong numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to spot inconsistencies and investigate results.
- Advanced Excel skills, including organising, checking and presenting data through clear tables and charts.
- Experience using Power BI reports or dashboards to retrieve, interrogate and interpret data.
- Strong PowerPoint skills and the ability to turn data into polished, concise client-facing reports.
- Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to quality control.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to explain performance data to non-technical colleagues and clients.
- The ability to manage multiple reporting deadlines and prioritise effectively without compromising accuracy.
- A self-motivated approach and the ability to work independently without detailed supervision.
- A collaborative, approachable and credible manner when working with both internal and external stakeholders.
- A degree or equivalent qualification.

If you're an analytical thinker with excellent Excel and PowerPoint skills, a sharp eye for detail and the confidence to communicate your findings, we'd love to hear from you.

title: E-Commerce Executive
company: Rise Technical Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
E-Commerce Executive
Milton Keynes
£35,000 - £40,000 + KPI Bonus + Progression + Benefits

Are you an ambitious and commercially minded E-commerce professional with WooCommerce experience, looking for an opportunity to take ownership of multiple international online stores while directly influencing traffic growth, conversion performance and revenue generation across established global brands?

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing business where you will play a key role in managing and developing ecommerce operations across multiple brands and international markets. You will be responsible for the day-to-day performance of WooCommerce websites, ensuring products, promotions and content are optimised to maximise online sales.

Working closely with marketing teams, external agencies and web developers, you will drive traffic acquisition strategies, improve customer journeys and identify opportunities to increase conversion rates and average order value. The role offers a strong blend of hands-on ecommerce management, digital marketing and commercial analysis.

The ideal candidate will have experience managing WooCommerce websites, a strong understanding of SEO, PPC and GA4, and a data-driven approach to improving ecommerce performance. This is a fantastic opportunity to make a visible impact within a well-established international business offering genuine autonomy and growth opportunities.
The Role:
- Manage and optimise WooCommerce ecommerce websites
- Maintain product content, pricing, promotions and merchandising activity
- Drive website traffic through SEO, PPC and digital marketing initiatives
- Analyse website performance and implement conversion rate improvements
- Coordinate projects with external agencies, developers and digital partners
- Produce ecommerce performance reports and support revenue growth targets

The Person:
- Experience in ecommerce, digital marketing or website management
- Strong knowledge of WooCommerce, SEO, PPC and Google Analytics 4
- Commercially aware with strong analytical skills
- Experience working with external agencies and suppliers
- Experience with CRO, A/B testing, Google Shopping or B2 B ecommerce advantageous

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Proximity Recruitment are searching for a talented Social Media Manager (up to £50,000 + Bonus + Benefits) to join an ambitious not-for-profit organisation embarking on a world leading environmental programme.

Hybrid working set-up from the Milton Keynes offices.

Responsibilities include:
- Develop & deliver a dynamic corporate social media plan to drive producer & retailer awareness, excitement, engagement, action & operational readiness.
- Ensure the Corporate & B2 B social media plans align with, & compliments, the wider communications strategy.
- Work with subject matter experts to identify and produce compelling & engaging content across a mix of channels including LinkedIn, YouTube & Reddit.
- Translate complex operational & technical information into clear, accessible & high-quality content for B2 B audiences.
- Manage channel activity including monitoring & responding to comments.
- Identify & build relationships with subject matter experts, B2 B influencers, trade bodies to amplify reach & credibility.
- Track performance across corporate & B2 B social channels & provide regular reports, insights & recommendations to the Head of Media & Content.
- Use data analytics to refine corporate social strategy/content & inform wider communications & engagement strategy.
- Partner with Corporate Affairs, Marketing & Operations to shape the corporate social strategy, plans & content.
- Support integrated campaigns across paid, earned & owned channels.

The successful candidate will be passionate, purpose driven & dynamic in approach to engage stakeholders & build awareness of the mission.

If you can work at pace, deal with the ambiguity of a dynamic, goal driven environment & have the passion for a mission focused social media project this could be the opportunity for you. Please don't hesitate to apply for more details.
